# learny

> Turn learning into play — build knowledge with joy


## Pages in this subsection

- [learny](learny.html.md): Turn learning into play — build knowledge with joy.
- [learny.tracing](learny.tracing.html.md): Learner modelling: what a student knows, estimated from what they have answered.
- [learny.tracing.diagnostics](learny.tracing.diagnostics.html.md): Diagnostics: when to believe the model, and how well it has predicted so far.
- [learny.tracing.estimators](learny.tracing.estimators.html.md): Estimators: how one response changes what we believe about a student.
- [learny.tracing.model](learny.tracing.model.html.md): The facade: one object that records responses and answers questions about a student.
- [learny.tracing.records](learny.tracing.records.html.md): Core data types for learner modelling: items, outcomes, and responses.
- [learny.tracing.stores](learny.tracing.stores.html.md): Where learner data lives, and how code reaches it.
